notes: Liliana, Waker of the Dead (M21): '[+1]: Each player discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.' Seat 0 holds one card, seat 1 holds one card. Both players discard (each hand -> graveyard). Seat 1 could discard, so it loses no life (an opponent who discards its last card is not an opponent who can't). Loyalty 4 -> 5.
